text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"No! I'm not dancing!
Why don't you just dance by yourself!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought her to the studio for a supplementary dance lesson,
but... time is just slipping away like this.
choice_data_list: It's meaningless if you don't dance...
There's no point if you don't dance...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't know anything about that!
I'm busy gathering magical energy!

My, then dancing is simply perfect!
I was just about to recharge my energy through dance myself!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes—with the Pre-Fi Season 3 ending theme, 'Princess☆Party'!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It'll be much faster just to show you!
Here we go—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Daaaaaah!
Hup, hop, haaaahーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Energy is overflowing
from Kawakami's body...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Steam rose from Kawakami Princess's body from her intense dance.
It looked just like the aura of magical energy...!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, what did you think? Did you witness my tremendous "Princess☆Energy"?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I've got it! Quick, teach me the choreo too!
I'm gonna show you I can build up crazy energy!
choice_data_list: (Well, at least it's good dance practice!)
(Well, it is good dance practice, right!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Rip and tear at full power♪
Make way for the warrior princess♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Everyone gather under the tiara♪

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Full of pep, Princess♪ Hoo-ah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Somehow, I feel all warm and fuzzy!
Could this mean... !?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! Energy has built up inside them!
Their expression has completely transformed!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Because it gets me so excited! Aren't there any other fun dances? Teach me!"
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't need a break?
There's a dance that builds up even more energy.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That's right! At times like this—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oregano Recovery!
Drink this magic water to blow away your fatigue!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Fully recharged! Time to dance my heart out at max full power~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It must have suited her fancy, as Sweep Tosho
kept on dancing more and more!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You know it?! Not bad, familiar!
What kind of dance is it, huh?!
choice_data_list: It's about the dance for the live show, but...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Concerts are a sheer bundle of energy!
We can certainly look forward to powering up even further!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it...!
...Familiar! Put on some music, quick!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, late into the night, Sweep Tosho practiced her dance with utmost seriousness!
